verdict.rationale: ClickUp lists its own Automations feature (clickup-docs-14) and says workflows can be triggered from ClickUp events (clickup-docs-3), so it has a first-party automation capability. Nothing in the evidence shows that capability running on a time-based schedule or recurrence; the n8n integration is a third-party tool and earns no credit. missing for 10: documented schedule- or cron-based triggers, recurring-event trigger configuration, documented automation actions for routine team work, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
